# `hk builtins`

- **Usage:** `hk builtins`
- **Effect:** read-only

List all available builtin linters

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

List builtin names, then use them in hk.pkl. External tools must be installed separately.

```sh

```
